ana: Heads-up: Q3 feature 'Adaptive Query Prioritization' needs final sequencing. Customer Alpha requires a private deployment with HSM; security review is blocking but runtime needs a KV-cache change and infra needs reserved capacity. We need clear tie-break rules if we can't staff everything at once.

ana: Proposal draft: 1) Security gating takes priority (HSM + legal sign-off). 2) If security clears, prioritize runtime changes over infra reservations by default (runtime delay increases unit cost and risks quality). 3) If both are required simultaneously and capacity is constrained, launch a single-region canary with degraded infra (no burst) + runtime perf flags to limit cost.

mike: Can we add concrete SLA targets so we can tell the customer a timeline?

ana: SLA targets (proposal): p99 latency target < 200ms for gen baseline; private pilot uptime 99% during the 2-week test window. Timeline estimate: security review 2w, runtime changes 3w (including perf testing), infra reservations 1w.

sasha: Runtime change touches KV cache hot-path — we should block rollout if p50 latency increases > 10% in perf tests.

kevin: Infra reservation depends on eu-west2 capacity; we can reserve burst slots but that adds incremental cost (~$X/week). Who owns procurement?

liz: I'll own procurement but need exact GPU count and expected QPS from product.

ana: Expected peak QPS: 1200 req/min, avg 500, typical seq len ~256. I'll coordinate load tests with eng-sre.

mike: For prioritization, propose a 'customer-driven' flag that elevates work if revenue > $100k ARR or strategic enterprise. That can be a tiebreaker in scheduling.

kevin: Also need a rollback plan: if runtime perf degrades in canary, fallback to a smaller model variant and route customers to hosted mode. Add to rollout doc.

ana: Added the rollback note. Rollout doc (working): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aqp-rollout

sre-bot: Incident note: previous KV cache change triggered canary alerts on 2025-11-12 (see #inc-3245). Reuse that canary pattern.

sasha: :eyes: We'll re-run that canary and add perf dashboards. Proposed canary config: 

```
canary:
  regions: [eu-west2]
  duration: 72h
  traffic: 5%
  rollback_if:
    p50_latency_increase_pct: 10
    error_rate_increase_pct: 0.5
```

kevin: Action items (agreed):
- Security: @mike to schedule security review (target date 2/18)
- Runtime: @sasha to branch & run perf tests (3w)
- Infra: @liz to confirm reservation details + cost estimate
- Product: @ana to send customer timeline by 2/20

mike: Security review needs secops + legal sign-off; I can set the meeting and send pre-reads.

ana: Thanks — I'll draft the customer email once dates are locked.

liz: Procurement can do burst reservations; need final GPU count by EOD tomorrow to lock pricing.

sasha: I'll drop the initial perf test plan and dashboards in this thread in the morning.

ana: Thanks team :rocket:
